summary: Live audits confirm zero critical and high advisories. Static review finds two audit parser defects. The shared lock prevents independent test verification.
blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] review-a: tests/deps_audit/run.sh:114-124 silently drops unknown or missing severity values. A payload such as {"pkg":[{}]} prints zero counts and exits 0. The same result follows for severity "urgent". Validate the severity before counting or applying an allowance. Return exit 2 for malformed advisory records. Add regression cases to tests/deps_audit/test.sh. Rationale: The audit reports a clean result when it cannot classify an advisory.

F2 [Blocker] review-a: tests/deps_audit/run.sh:86-88 accepts a GHSA token without a reason. A bare GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp line exempts the high advisory in case-high. Require a nonempty reason before an entry can exempt an advisory. Add a missing-reason regression case. Rationale: plan.md:20 and test.sh:20-23 require an advisory id with a PM-accepted reason.
